limits: Only macOS 26.6.2 arm64 with Codex CLI 0.167.0 was exercised; other OS and CLI versions were not tested.
This refresh installed from a local filesystem marketplace. Codex remote Git marketplace install/update for the 0.1.5 to 0.1.6 transition remains unverified pending a pushed candidate.
The temporary Codex profile also surfaced host-provisioned plugins; none of their tools were invoked during the synthetic checks.
Superpowers evidence covers the selected writing-plans boundary only, not its full upstream workflow.
Synthetic prompts consumed model tokens; no private user content was supplied.
The temporary Codex profile was logged out and removed after validation; raw transcripts are not included in the repository.

acceptance_refresh.carry_forward_basis: Installation and all package versions were checked in the isolated profile. Startup and preference-off checks are carried forward from the 2026-11-13 Codex refresh; other behavior checks are carried forward from 2026-11-12 because skills, runtime, hooks, MCP server and native execution resources did not change.
